scientific_claim: The selective-wake 003 negative is attributable primarily to cue ranking, not the eight-active capacity ceiling. On both held-out files an evaluator-only optimal eight-motif subset retained 100% of the full 16-motif incremental correct predictions, exceeded the frozen occurrence-cue subset by at least 0.2075 retained-benefit fraction and the static pressure subset by at least 0.3208, while cue/optimal set overlap was at most 0.4545 Jaccard.
implication: Eight active structures are sufficient for the tested files if the active set is chosen using a cue correlated with future predictive utility. Raw occurrence frequency alone is not adequate.
next_question: On fresh immutable held-out files, can a non-oracle error-guided cue based only on observed first-half prediction outcomes choose the eight active motifs well enough to recover >=70% of full-model benefit without future-half access or capacity growth?
scope: diagnostic attribution only; evaluator-optimal selection is not a deployable policy
